items.title: Mauritius was the first country I visited outside India, back in 2011. 🇲🇺 While I agree with all the points mentioned by @TravelBluez in the post below, one point deserves even more emphasis: 👉 If you are on SIC trips (shared coaches), you are at a disadvantage. If possible, opt for private tours or a self-drive car instead. Can’t agree more with this. During our trip, we wasted hours visiting places like a glass factory, wooden toy factory, diamond shop, and other tourist-shopping stops that we had no real interest in. On top of that, we spent a lot of time simply waiting for fellow travellers, even though we were always on time and then sitting in the coach. 😅 The biggest disappointment was seeing so many beautiful spots on the way where we would have loved to stop and spend some time, but couldn’t because the shared coach had a fixed itinerary. And at every attraction, you are given a fixed time slot, so instead of enjoying the place, you end up keeping one eye on your watch. ⏰ Your Mauritius trip will be far more rewarding if you choose private tours or rent a self-drive car.
